title: Chapter 1088
paragraphs: Chapter 1088
Episode 255. The Death of Kelliark Zipfel, and....(5)
Annihilation.

A power that could, by rights, surely exterminate anything that existed in the mortal world was gathering in one place. No less than four Genesis Knights, all of them were literally unleashing their full strength.
To cut, break, and kill the enemy.
Blades and claws, glistening with a will and hatred close to a curse, were rushing towards Kelliark.
The first to aim for Kelliark's back was Luna's crimson sword. Her eyes held a killing intent deeper and darker than anyone else among the four.
Shiiit-!
Space distorted on the blade of Krantel, leaving a bizarre and sharp trace. Kelliark teleported a distance of about three steps at that moment to dodge the attack.
The lingering energy of the crimson sword that extended from the blade grazed Kelliark's shoulder. The two vertical slashes that followed in a consecutive attack also left only minor scratches.
“Yes, seeing your face, I remember. The events from other dimensions... how could I have lived, having forgotten you.”
“Luna Runcandel, you insist on playing the hero here as well.”
Luna momentarily lost speed due to a spatial explosion that suddenly unfolded before her eyes. In that gap, Kelliark created more distance and strengthened his shield.
A rapidly inflating and expanding shield; Kelliark had already positioned himself deep within it, disappearing from Luna's sight.
The coalition members watching could not help but doubt their eyes.
'With just a shield... he is withstanding the ultimate techniques of the Genesis Knights...!'

The Plutonian Domination Swords from Jin and Vahn could be seen being blocked, colliding with the shield. However, the Genesis Knights themselves were not agitated at all, as if they had already expected it.
While the advance of the Plutonian Domination Swords seemed to have stopped, only Luna, who had penetrated first, continued to chase Kelliark.
Kelliark's magic, raging within the shield, was instantly incinerating Luna's entire body. Among the Genesis Knights, only Luna could withstand those flames so directly.

“That hard and persistent, disgusting habit of yours is still the same. I will praise you highly for daring to raise your sword against me even after recalling those numerous humiliations and pathetic defeats.”
“Don't show off, Kelliark. Isn't it that you're the one who has to face us, not just us?”
At the end of those words, a single golden ray of light pierced through Kelliark's chest. It was Malugia's sun energy.
Malugia, she had been clearly helping the Vamel Alliance since a while ago. To be precise, she had been using the other egos of the Sun God and the Vamel Alliance since she had drawn Focal in.

A piercing wound is fatal for a human. Especially in the place where the heart is. However, Kelliark did not even spit out blood. The pierced wound was briefly gathered with a mosaic-like form of magic and was seen recovering in an instant. Kelliark was using a considerable level of reality manipulation with only his own power, without the Origin Stone.
“Yes, it must be a very fortunate thing for you all.”
Kaaaaang-!
The spear of Malugia that had pierced Kelliark returned at the speed of light. At the same time, a spear of the same form flew towards Luna.
The first spear tore through all the shields Malugia had formed like a piece of paper and pierced through her neck.
And unlike Kelliark, she flinched, showing a sign of being hit. Because she was pouring almost all her power into the dimensional gate opened with Focal's power, she could not respond properly.
Luna perfectly evaded the first spear, and the second spear that followed, and once again closed the distance with Kelliark.
But the moment she swung Krantel, a third spear that had shot up from behind her without any warning pierced her thigh.
Kelliark had naturally expected her to falter for a moment, but Luna just pulled out the spear that had pierced through the front of her thigh and swung Krantel at Kelliark's neck.
Deep.
The blade dug in and cut nearly halfway through Kelliark's neck. That too just became a 'thing that didn't happen' due to reality manipulation.
“Now!”
Luna shouted. To Malugia, and to her companions.

From what she had observed, the only time an extremely minor opening appeared in Kelliark was when he was using his manipulation. She hadn't given a signal when Malugia's spear had pierced his chest because she wasn't sure, but now she was certain.
Jin, Vahn, Murakan.
Their ultimate techniques had not failed to pierce the shield. They had deliberately been pretending to be blocked. Kelliark had not noticed that fact.
It was a gamble.

If Kelliark had been focused solely on the Genesis Knights, this method could not have succeeded. The Genesis Knights had, in an extremely simple manner, just maintained the power of their unfolded ultimate techniques without fully clashing with the shield.
Because Malugia and Luna had been relentlessly pressuring him, Kelliark had not read that minor trick.
And if there was one more reason.

The Kelliark Zipfel of the 33rd dimension had never properly experienced the 'Plutonian Domination Swords'. Because in all the time he had been conquering all dimensions except this one, the Battle Goddess Vahn had never once appeared in the mortal world in a complete state like now.
[You are a lucky bastard, Kelliark Zipfel. You have never spent the same era as me in any dimension.]

Plutonian Domination Sword - Wave; the lightning that had been stopped right before the shield began to move. Even before the lightning fully touched it, the shield melted away like ice, and a path was opened.
[Ah, perhaps it can't be said to be all good. Since this is now Brother Jin's era... he is greater than I.]
Kelliark's eyes widened.

For the shield that had been spread across the entire battlefield to disappear in such an instant was not in his calculations. Even the shields that had been spread far away, not directly touching the lightning of the Plutonian Domination Swords, were all crumbling.
At the same time, Malugia focused all the power she had been pouring beyond the dimensional gate onto Kelliark, and Luna retreated in the direction the Genesis Knights were rushing in.
“Finish him, youngest.”
Jin, Vahn, and Murakan passed Luna. It was as if three tsunamis had risen, not people.
“Keuk...!”
Golden cubes pressed in on Kelliark from all directions.
'Was Malugia's objective not to strike my home base... but to aim for me from the beginning. To be fooled by the shallow trick of the Vamel Alliance's Genesis Knights, this is truly dangerous.'

Kelliark had not let his guard down even once since the battle began. He had not recklessly attacked Jin to avoid allowing even a small counterattack, and had poured his full strength into Malugia, whom he had to face with top priority.
It was just that it wasn't enough.
To face Malugia and all the Genesis Knights at once on his own was an impossible task, even for the leader of the Demon Army.
'Just as Malugia is different from the other Malugias I have experienced, is it the same for the Genesis Knights of this dimension?'
A crisis.
Kelliark Zipfel was feeling a sense of crisis creeping up on him for the first time in a truly long time.

However, he did not think of it as a mistake by any means. Neither the fact that he had been caught in Malugia's trap and had come to this dimension alone, nor the fact that he had to face Malugia and this dimension's Genesis Knights at once as soon as he arrived.
Rather, it was becoming proof that he had made the right judgment.

-Furthermore, such will sometimes leads to miracles. That is why the powerhouses of the 677th dimension have so far failed to kill the anomaly named Jin Runcandel. The Vamel Alliance is a powerful enemy, the likes of which no other dimension has ever faced.
-My thinking was short-sighted.

-You all probably believe that since we rule all dimensions except the 677th, and since we possess a completed Origin Stone, we can surely eliminate them. Wrong. Their swords are already at our throats.
Kelliark recalled the last meeting and smirked.
[You still have the leisure for that.]
Vahn's blade fell on Kelliark's forehead.
It was impossible to dodge. The golden cubes that Malugia had formed had blocked all paths of retreat, and the locations where there were gaps were all filled with Murakan's True Advent of Darkness.
Having no choice, Kelliark had to catch Vahn's blade with his bare hands.
“Keoheok...! How could I not laugh, Vahn. If I had made a slightly clumsy judgment, I would have been defeated by you bastards without even being able to come to this land.”
Kelliark said, spitting out a mouthful of blood.
Just as it was his first time experiencing the Plutonian Domination Sword, it was also the first time for Vahn to meet an enemy who could withstand her sword in this way.
An enemy who could catch the blade that condensed the final chapter of her ultimate technique with his bare hands, without a weapon, was, of course, something she had never even imagined.
A horrific vibration, explosions, and a deafening roar.

In the midst of it, Kelliark's trembling hand was slowly pushing Vahn back. Even though he was spitting out blood and his eyes had rolled back into his head, his magic was rather being refined and amplified even more.
However, there was not just one Plutonian Domination Sword.
Jin Runcandel, the very person who had summoned the leader of the Demon Army to this place, his sword was falling behind Kelliark.
“Kraaaaaak...!”
He barely managed to duck his body and avoid having his head split in half. Jin's blade cut his back and fell to the floor.
The clear sensation of the blade catching on bone was transmitted, and an amount of blood that was unbelievable to come from a single human body was gushing out.
Jin, covered in that blood, once again cut Kelliark's waist horizontally and roared.

Even at the moment his body was split in half, Kelliark did not let go of Vahn's sword that he was holding. At that part, even the Genesis Knights couldn't help but feel a chill run down their spines.
Square-shaped magics were covering Kelliark's wounds. Reality manipulation; even if a blade were pushed into it, there was no reaction, as if it had just struck empty air.
However, Kelliark, who had finished his recovery, showed a ragged breath. He was drenched in sweat as if exhausted, and the flow of his emitted magic was not as stable as before.

It was at that moment that the power of the Golden Fleet returned. The fleet, as Jin had ordered in advance, immediately began to retreat, and in an instant, dimensional gates back to Tikan opened all over the sky.
Jin and Vahn also retrieved their swords at the same time. To fight Kelliark to the end now would be no different from giving the bone to take the flesh.
As if they had been waiting for the moment the Genesis Knights pulled back, the sight of Malugia descending to the ground and facing Kelliark directly followed.
With his entire body pierced by dozens of golden spears, Kelliark looked up at the retreating Genesis Knights, at Jin, and said this.
“This debt... I shall repay it soon, Jin Runcandel.”
